subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which context-overflow diagnostic facts should be shown directly to users, and what redaction rule should apply to session/channel identifiers?
rationale: The code already has provider/model, effective budget, estimated or observed count, overage, route, and session facts in logs or state, but choosing which of those belong in channel-visible replies is a UX and privacy policy decision.

options.title: Show redacted diagnostics
options.body: Expose provider/model, effective limit or budget, observed or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted session/channel label while keeping raw identifiers in logs.

options.title: Keep specifics operator-only
options.body: Leave chat-visible copy generic and document the log, status, or diagnostic command operators should use for exact context-pressure details.

options.title: Full diagnostic reply
options.body: Show raw session/channel keys and exact token/model diagnostics directly in user-visible replies for fastest fleet debugging, accepting the identifier exposure tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Show redacted diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose provider/model, effective limit or budget, observed or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted session/channel label while keeping raw identifiers in logs.
